'''Mikhail Petrovich Fedoruk''' ({{langx|ru|Михаил Петрович Федорук}}) (born February 18, 1956) — is a [[Rector (academia)|rector]] of [[Novosibirsk State University]], Doctor of Physics and Mathematics.<ref>[http://www.prometeus.nsc.ru/math/ict/fedoruk/index.ssi Russian: Биобиблиография ученых ИВТ СО РАН]</ref>

== Biography ==
Mikhail P. Fedoruk born February 18, 1956, in the [[Kochenyovsky District]] of [[Novosibirsk Oblast|Novosibirsk District]], [[Russia]].

In 1982 he graduated from the Faculty of Physics, Novosibirsk State University and began his scientific career with postgraduate study in the Institute of Theoretical and Applied Mechanics SB RAS. 
His teaching activities are connected with [[Novosibirsk State University]]. Since 1995 he worked as a lecturer at the Faculty of Mathematics and Mechanics, in 2003 became the first deputy dean of the faculty.

June 22, 2012 he was elected rector of NSU.<ref>[http://www.nsu.ru/exp/p5018aa3cfda3a06a09091225 New rector of NSU (Russian)] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140903155921/http://www.nsu.ru/exp/p5018aa3cfda3a06a09091225 |date=2014-09-03 }}</ref>

In 2022, he signed the [[2022 address of the Russian Union of Rectors|Address of the Russian Union of Rectors]], which called to support [[Vladimir Putin|Putin]] in his [[2022 Russian invasion of Ukraine|invasion of Ukraine]].<ref name="rectors">[https://rsr-online.ru/news/2022-god/obrashchenie-rossiyskogo-soyuza-rektorov1/ Original text of the Address of the Russian Union of Rectors]<br/>[https://twitter.com/rvdwalle/status/1500413514384560136/photo/1 English translation of the Address]<br/>{{cite news |last=Naujokaitytė |first=Goda |date=2022-03-10 |title=Russian rectors' support for Putin prompts UK universities to cut links |url=https://sciencebusiness.net/news/russian-rectors-support-putin-prompts-uk-universities-cut-links |work=Science. Business |location= |access-date=}}<br/>{{cite news |last=Lem |first=Pola |date=2022-03-07 |title=Russian rectors' union echoes Kremlin propaganda on Ukraine |url=https://www.timeshighereducation.com/news/russian-rectors-union-echoes-kremlin-propaganda-ukraine |work=The World University Rankings |location= |access-date=}}<br/>{{cite news |last=O’Malley |first=Brendan |date=2022-03-06 |title=Russian Union of Rectors backs Putin's action in Ukraine |url=https://www.universityworldnews.com/post.php?story=20220306120204111 |work=University World News |location= |access-date=}}</ref>

He is married and has a son.
